title: Chapter 252 The Final Showdown
content:
Chapter 252 The Final Showdown

Thousands of light griffin knights were exposed, and the light attribute energy on the knights and giant light griffins flashed, like thousands of small suns hanging in the sky.

But two hundred of the knights were obviously not in good condition. Only the giant light griffins were stimulating powerful light attribute energy to provide energy for the powerful defensive magic. The two hundred knights were already in pain and could not extricate themselves.

"Attack!"

The light griffin knights obviously knew about the Zerg Queen's spawning attack. They ignored the two hundred light griffin knights who were attacked by the Zerg Queen and launched a powerful attack directly on the Zerg destroyers.

Another three-shot light arrow with special magic blessing and full power!

Thousands of light arrows shot at the Zerg destroyers who were attacking from a distance with unstoppable momentum and lightning speed!

This powerful attack, which has reached the strength of six stars, is the strongest attack launched by the light griffin knights using powerful magic and long-term power!

Any arms in the Zerg army that go to block it will only increase casualties.

Wu Qing didn't believe that such a powerful attack could be launched again by the five-star Light Griffin Knight, so he ignored the Zerg Destroyer who was attacked, and mobilized his troops to attack the Light Griffin Knight with all his strength.

The armor-piercing spikes of two thousand five-star Zerg Hydralisks with terrifying lethality and the terrible biological bombs of two thousand five-star Zerg Wyverns were the main force attacking the Light Griffin Knight.

Under the powerful attack of the same level, the light attribute energy on the Light Griffin Knight, which was as dazzling as a small sun, quickly decayed.

"Pah pah pah..."

Two hundred Light Griffin Knights attacked by the Zerg Queen's spawning exploded and died one after another, turning into light and disappearing.

The two hundred surviving Light Griffins cried out in grief, but did not fly away, but continued to charge towards the direction of the Zerg Destroyer with other Light Griffin Knights.

Perhaps the three bursts of fire launched by the Light Griffin Knights consumed a lot of their energy and energy, and they could not recover for a while, so they could only focus on defense and did not launch other attacks for the time being.

After the strongest attack of the Light Griffin Knight, he did not retreat and escape, but continued to attack the Zerg Destroyer phalanx!

The three arrows of the Light Griffin Knight seemed to be blessed by a magic that would hit the target. All the two thousand five-star Zerg Destroyers were hit by arrows, and some were hit by two or three arrows!

The terrible light arrows with the power of six-star attacks made huge holes in the five-star Zerg Destroyers, almost making all the two thousand five-star Zerg Destroyers silent!

Most of the huge bodies of the Zerg Destroyers that were hit by three consecutive attacks disappeared. They stubbornly persisted for a while and turned into light and left!

Since its birth, the Zerg Destroyer has finally suffered losses!

The first loss was to the strongest five-star Zerg Destroyer!

This shows the terrible attack ability of the Light Griffin Knights of the Alien Race!

But the number of Light Griffin Knights is still too small. For Wu Qing, such a loss is just a loss of a batch of resources. As long as he can earn it back from the Alien Race, he will not feel heartbroken.

The Griffin Knights of Light will continue to attack the Zerg Destroyers. They are recovering, and the Zerg Queen is also recovering.

The Zerg Queen's spawning attack cannot be used continuously in a short period of time, but other abilities can be used after a short buffer.

Dozens of trapping nets were thrown into the airspace where the Griffin Knights of Light were, and all the surviving birds were caught in the net.

There was a crackling sound. Except for the powerful Griffin Knights of Light who were less affected, the speed of the surviving birds suddenly dropped, and they were all shot down by the anti-aircraft firepower of the Zerg army.

The Griffin Knights of Light were caught in the trapping net of the Zerg Queen. The light attribute energy on their bodies flashed, and basically broke the restriction of the trapping net, and they could still maintain most of the flying speed.

The mysterious human knights who were rescued by the aliens had personally experienced the powerful restriction and restraint ability of the Zerg Queen's trapping net. The Griffin Knights of Light who participated in the raid were prepared, making the Zerg Queen's trapping net lose most of its effect.

Thousands of light griffins, all of which were five-star strength, had been responsible for providing light attribute energy for powerful defensive magic, with the primary goal of breaking through the Zerg army's anti-aircraft firepower, so they had never attacked.

Now that two hundred five-star light griffins had lost their knights, they let themselves go, and powerful light attribute energy attacks were ejected from their mouths, rushing into the oncoming Zerg dragon group at high speed.

Groups of white light exploded in the Zerg dragon group, and groups of two-star Zerg dragons fell in response. Many Zerg dragons turned into light and disappeared directly under the powerful purification and annihilation energy attack.

The Zerg army had more five-star soldiers participating in air defense, which was quickly consuming the defensive magic power of the light griffin knights.

The light griffin knights recovered their attack capabilities, and they continued to attack the Zerg destroyers regardless of the Zerg army's powerful anti-aircraft firepower.

A series of light arrows shot into the Zerg destroyer phalanx, continuing to make up for the severely damaged five-star Zerg destroyers.

At this time, the attack power of the Light Griffin Knight has returned to the normal five-star range. Although it has also reached the top level of five-star soldiers' attack power, it is very difficult to quickly kill the five-star Zerg Destroyer with powerful self-healing ability.

The power of the light arrows of the Light Griffin Knights during the first three-shot attack was enough to make a five-star Zerg Destroyer's body disappear by one-fifth, but the power of the single light arrow they fired now could only make a small hole in the body of the five-star Zerg Destroyer.

It is very difficult to kill the opponent quickly in a battle between soldiers of the same level, not to mention that the Zerg Destroyer is one of the most difficult soldiers to kill. Now it is difficult to kill them with only these eight or nine hundred Light Griffin Knights.

The Zerg Queen's trap net descended again, and it was divided into multiple times, covering the Light Griffin Knights of the alien race layer by layer.

Faced with the trap attack that can suddenly expand from a small ball into a net, the Light Griffin Knights can't avoid it with their strength.

Under the layers of trapping nets, the light attribute energy on the Light Griffin Knights kept flickering and becoming weaker, and their flying speed dropped again.

The five-star Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes, which had been looking for an attack opportunity for a long time, flew out another twenty, rushed to the best attack position calculated by the Queen at an extremely fast speed, and exploded directly!

"Boom...!"

The horrible explosions overlapped and exerted terrible power!

The Light Griffin Knights of the Alien Tribe, who were restrained by the Zerg Queen's trapping net, suffered all the damage!

The Zerg flying dragons not far away and the Zerg hydralisks below were all hit hard by the explosion and entered a defensive state.

The two hundred Light Griffins of the Alien Tribe who lost their knights fell down with a wail, and the remaining Light Griffin Knights, whose originally dazzling light attribute energy was already so weak that it was barely visible.

Many Light Griffin Knights and their Light Griffin mounts were severely damaged!

Two thousand five-star Zerg Hydralisks and two thousand five-star Zerg Dragons did not give the Light Griffin Knights a chance to relax, and their fierce attacks continued to hit the Light Griffin Knights and their mounts.

The armor-piercing spikes of the five-star Zerg Hydralisks finally pierced the bodies of the Light Griffin and the knights on their backs.

The biological bombs of the five-star Zerg Dragons blew up the defenses of the Light Griffin and the knights on their backs. The micro-biological bombs and highly corrosive mucus touched the bodies of the Light Griffin and the knights on their backs. The explosion and corrosion finally hurt their bodies.

For all this damage, the Light Griffin Knights ignored it. They continued their mission and shot light arrows at the Zerg Destroyer!

The Zerg Queen's trapping net continued to spray, tightly binding the already scarred Light Griffin Knight.

The layers of trapping nets wrapped around the Light Griffin Knight, making the Light Griffin Knight, who was constantly attacked and severely injured, unable to attack again.

"Stab, stab, stab...!"

Another two thousand powerful armor-piercing spikes accurately shot through the bodies of the light griffins and knights, and the light griffin knights of the alien race began to fall continuously!

With the same five-star strength, except for the Zerg Queen's spawning attack that can kill with one hit, it is not easy to kill the light griffin knights with other attacks.

The light griffin knights that fell to the ground and the light griffins that fell earlier did not die. Some of them were still on the ground and had the strength to fight.

Wu Qing asked the Zerg army to clear a piece of land for them, suppressing them with firepower, but not killing them.

The parasitic control ability of the Zerg Queen can be used directly once. Wu Qing asked the two hundred five-star Zerg Queens to control the two hundred light griffin knights first. As for the light griffins, let them toss first.

Wu Qing and the Queen of Insects, through preliminary research on the alien knights and those light griffins controlled yesterday, found that the parasitic knights and parasitic light griffins who lost their faith could use the heavenly silkworm to practice the nine changes of the heavenly silkworm, continue to practice light attribute energy, and exert their original strength.

With the assistance of the heavenly silkworm and the practice of the nine changes of the heavenly silkworm, their strength is even stronger than before.

So for these powerful five-star light griffin knights, Wu Qing thinks that controlling and transforming them may be more cost-effective than simply killing them to obtain resources.

These powerful enemy troops controlled by parasitism have limited effects in the Zerg army, but they are very powerful in the Great Xia Territory and the Alliance army.

For the Great Xia Territory and the Alliance, Wu Qing is going to let Hu Tu and Meng develop on their own, and they need these high-star troops to support them.

Except for the Zerg puppies who can support Hu Tu and Meng in large quantities, Wu Qing himself does not have enough other Zerg troops, and will not participate in the affairs of the Great Xia Territory and the Alliance for the time being.
